notes.title: Trading Cards & Emoticons & Badges & Backgrounds
notes.content:
Hey friends!

This is a demo of Trading Cards, Emoticons (also there will be BGs and Badges) that we will see with you on Steam, if we overcome the necessary barrier, it's about the Number of Additions to the Steam Wishlist, Purchases and the Number of Game Launches.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257444/ad2e13ead1be88d2870edecd82b828587bebcf5a.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257444/3d858c045aa81cb4f4a47ecf0d061c7b08a3568d.png

Not all of the items that will be added are shown here, this is just a demonstration of a small part :)

What do you think about it? We will be glad to hear your opinion in the comments.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257444/23bcce2d192ade30fffba330d9b0657311e98aac.png

We really appreciate this, as well as your help in obtaining these trading cards!


Contact us – softpaws.dev@gmail.com

notes.title: RELEASE DATE ANNOUNCE
notes.content:
Friends, we hasten to inform you that we have decided on the release date!

November 12th at 10:00 AM (Eastern Time, UTC-5) / 7:00 AM (Pacific Time, UTC-8).

https://i.imgur.com/ssq746C.png

To make sure you don't forget, you can add the game to your vishlist.
We'll be looking forward to seeing you at the release!
Thanks ♥

If you have any questions, feel free to email softpaws.dev@gmail.com
